Bridge all surviving operations, including the beta updatePin action, and account for seven genuinely removed deprecated top-level /identityProviders routes per profile. The nested /identity/identityProviders operations already existed separately in each legacy spec, are not selected by this regex, and remain available. Existing curated top-level suppression is retained; exact curated entries fill gaps left by v1-only derived data.

mappings.notes: Legacy oauth2PermissionGrant_(List|Create|Get|Update|Delete)OAuth2PermissionGrant produces the repeated resource subject. The five collection/item CRUD operations already receive Oauth2PermissionGrant from structural path naming in both profiles. Count and delta have distinct nonrepeated subjects and are neighbors, not rename targets.

Legacy dataPolicyOperation_(List|Create|Get|Update|Delete)DataPolicyOperation produces the repeated resource subject. Structural path naming already emits DataPolicyOperation for the five collection/item CRUD operations in both profiles; count is an unaffected distinct subject.

Strip the IdentityProtection prefix from descendant resource/count/action nouns, excluding the root already suppressed by directive 1. The reviewed scope is every surviving descendant operation: 41 v1.0 and 56 beta. Existing v1.0 derived resource/action names and verbs remain authoritative; a curated prefix strip covers beta and operation paths without derived entries.

Suppress only GET/PATCH/DELETE of the user authentication singleton. Keep all child authentication-method resources and actions. Existing v1.0 derived suppression is retained; curated exact matching also supplies beta and collision-data-independent behavior.

The exact subjects select ten beta collection/item CRUD operations for sensitivityLabels and nested sublabels. No such root exists in the v1.0 compatible or legacy module specs. Count, rights, compute/evaluate calls, and user-scoped information-protection resources have different subjects and are retained.

New selects POST /users/{user-id}/authentication/passwordMethods. Neither actual legacy nor compatible profile contains a password-method PATCH; do not invent an update mapping. Existing v1.0 derived creation suppression is retained, with an exact curated POST entry for both profiles. Preserve password-method reads/count.

Resolve unnumbered variants to the singular /identity/conditionalAccess/authenticationStrength root and descendants, including count Get variants and the updateAllowedCombinations Update action. Do not suppress combinationConfigurations POST: CreateViaIdentity/CreateViaIdentityExpanded remain after the selected Create variants are removed (confirmed by shipped metadata). The usage function has the prefixed UsageIdentityConditionalAccessAuthenticationStrengthPolicy subject and remains available, also confirmed by shipped metadata. Legacy beta plural /authenticationStrengths uses numbered variants and is absent from the compatible spec; never broaden suppression to that alias. The beta singular findByMethodMode function is also absent from compatible input. Preserve existing v1.0 derived precedence.

The numbered IdentityProvider Update1 variants resolve to legacy PATCH /identityProviders/{identityProvider-id}, not PATCH /identity/identityProviders/{identityProviderBase-id} (the shipped nested command has unnumbered Update variants). The entire deprecated top-level set is absent from both compatible specs and is already accounted for in directive 1 source-fidelity tests and the existing curated prefix suppression. No redundant override is added; preserve nested provider PATCH.
